build_task_template: build a PHYRE task scene with jars, bars, and balls using the build_task template
create_bar_from_point_angle: create a static bar from a point and angle with optional length parameters
create_bar_between_points: create a static bar connecting two coordinate points in the PHYRE scene
rotate_coordinates: rotate 2D coordinates by a given number of radians using trigonometry
review_build_task: review the build_task function that generates PHYRE puzzle scenes with configurable gaps and shelf angles
